title: Cardano holders are being asked to bet $5 million on copper hitting a new record
summary: Title: ADA news: Cardano holders are being asked to bet $5 million on copper hitting a new record URL Source: https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/10/23/cardano-holders-are-being-asked-to-bet-usd5-million-on-copper-hitting-a-new-record Published Time: 2026-10-23T04:36:51.418Z Markdown Content: Updated Oct 23, 2026, 1:14 a.m. EDT Published Oct 23, 2026, 12:36 a.m. EDT 3 min read ![Image 1: Copper coils. (Shutterstock)](https://www.coindesk.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fs3y3vcno%2Fproduction%2Fd015970fe04575c3819700e01e757b872ee9ad32-1500x1000.jpg%3Frect%3D0%2C78%2C1500%2C844%26w%3D1920%26h%3D1080%26auto%3Dformat&w=1200&q=75) Cardano holders are being asked to bet $5 million on copper hitting a new record. (Shutterstock) Summary * Toto Finance is seeking 22 million ADA, or about $5 million, from Cardano’s treasury to buy and tokenize copper, with voting set to close Nov. 15. * Copper would need to rise about 49.4% for the treasury to recover its investment if the full budget is spent and ADA’s dollar price remains unchanged. * The proposal would use more than half of Cardano’s remaining withdrawal allowance, while Toto could receive up to 3.36 million ADA and retain commercial rights to its separately funded tokenized-copper business. Cardano’s community treasury is being asked to spend about $5 million on a copper reserve, with costs that would require the metal to rise nearly 50% to recover the original investment under the proposal’s assumptions. [Toto Finance](https://totofinance.com/newsroom/toto-finance-submits-cardano-treasury-proposal-strategic-copper-reserve/), a company that turns physical commodities into blockchain tokens, wants 22 million ADA for what it calls the Cardano Strategic Copper Reserve. Voting closes Nov. 15. Copper, also known as “Dr. Copper” for its role as a barometer of global growth, is widely tracked as a signal of industrial expansion, with rising prices often pointing to an economic boom.

(Ethereum) Summary * Ethereum researchers have proposed cutting transaction finality from about 16 minutes to roughly four minutes, though the unfinished plan has no activation date. * Faster finality could reduce costs for cross-chain transfer services by allowing them to recover and reuse funds more quickly. * The proposal would separate validators’ block-selection and finality votes, potentially enabling further speed gains and an eventual shift to quantum-resistant signatures. Ethereum researchers want to cut the wait for a transaction to become final from about 16 minutes to roughly four, a change that could make it cheaper to move money between blockchains.
